title: Sales and Growth Intern
cardDesc: You'll prospect and help close deals with founders, executives, and professionals, learning the CRM and the sales cycle hands-on.
cardBullets: Interest in sales or B2B services
applySubject: Application for Sales and Growth Intern

grid.label: Location
grid.value: WeWork Enam Sambhav, C - 20, G Block Rd, G Block BKC, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051

schemaDescription: Join Myntmore as a Sales and Growth Intern in BKC, Mumbai. Learn high-ticket B2B sales and executive personal branding from the inside. Full-time internship with incentives.
aboutIntro: We're looking for an ambitious, confident, and growth-minded Sales & Growth Intern who wants to learn how high-ticket B2B sales, executive personal branding, and agency growth actually work from the inside. You'll work closely with the sales team to connect with founders, C-level executives, doctors, consultants, and professionals, learning how to prospect, qualify, pitch, and close deals in the real world.

responsibilities.title: Find the Stars
responsibilities.desc: Identify and connect with potential clients, including high-level executives, startup founders, doctors, lawyers, and more. Help them unlock the power of personal branding with Myntmore.

responsibilities.title: Master the CRM Game
responsibilities.desc: Take charge of managing our CRM system, keeping it organised and up to date with valuable insights. Play a key role in streamlining our sales process and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

responsibilities.title: Seal the Deal
responsibilities.desc: Lead prospects through the sales funnel, from the initial conversation all the way to a successful close. Confidently communicate our value proposition and build genuine, lasting client relationships.

responsibilities.title: Stay Ahead of the Curve
responsibilities.desc: Keep a pulse on industry trends and competitor strategies, bringing fresh ideas to the table. Help us continuously refine our sales tactics and position Myntmore at the top of the market.

responsibilities.title: Be the Voice of Myntmore
responsibilities.desc: Represent the brand with energy, professionalism, and passion across every call and interaction. Leave a positive, lasting impression on every prospect you speak with.

whoYouAre.label: Interest in Sales
whoYouAre.desc: A genuine passion for sales, business development, and client psychology

whoYouAre.label: Confident Communicator
whoYouAre.desc: Comfortable speaking to senior professionals and founders on calls and in messages

whoYouAre.label: Organised
whoYouAre.desc: Keen to learn and maintain CRM tools (Zoho or similar) with clean pipeline hygiene

whoYouAre.label: Competitive & Driven
whoYouAre.desc: Motivated by setting targets and beating them

whoYouAre.label: Quick Learner
whoYouAre.desc: Absorbs product knowledge and objection handling fast

whoYouAre.label: High Energy
whoYouAre.desc: Brings positivity, curiosity, and persistence to every conversation

whoYouAre.label: Team Player
whoYouAre.desc: Collaborates closely with content, ops, and strategy teams

whoYouAre.label: Career Mindset
whoYouAre.desc: Looking to build a long-term career in B2B sales, growth marketing, or entrepreneurship

whyJoin: Get hands-on sales training that most graduates never receive. Learn how executive deals are closed, work from WeWork BKC Mumbai, and earn incentives on closed deals with clear PPO potential.
